newsitem.title: USA: Playboy unit buys catalog mailing list.
newsitem.headline: Playboy unit buys catalog mailing list.

text.p: Critics' Choice Video Inc, a unit of Playboy Enterprises Inc, said Thursday it bought rights to the entire mailing list and other selected assets of Time Warner Inc Viewers' Edge video catalog.

Herb Laney, executive vice president of Playboy and president of the company's Catalog Group, said, "This acquisition will create new customers for our Critics' Choice Video catalog, increasing our ability to grow this business and consolidating our position as the nation's largest- circulation catalog of movies and special interest videos."
Critics' Choice Video offers more than 5,000 video titles and is published quarterly. Playboy acquired 80 percent of the catalog in July 1988 and the remaining 20 percent in July 1993.

Since 1988, revenues of the Catalog Group have grown from $3 million to nearly $72 million in the fiscal 1996 year, which ended June 30. In addition to Critics' Choice Video and Collectors' Choice Music, the group also includes the Playboy catalog, which markets a range of the company's products.
